items.title: Moderna, Merck melanoma cancer vaccine is a 'grand slam': Dr. Ezekiel Emanuel

items.title: Analysis-Moderna, Merck breakthrough could usher in wave of cancer vaccines
items.summary: CHICAGO, Aug 19 () - Merck and Moderna's success with a personalized cancer vaccine designed to keep melanoma at bay opens a new avenue of treatment that doctors hope will work against many types of tumors. Unlike chemotherapy, which kills both healthy and cancerous cells, or immunotherapy, which revs up the immune system, personalized cancer ‌vaccines train the immune system to specifically target mutations found only on a person's tumor.

items.title: Review & Preview: Good Medicine
items.summary: Promising news from a major drug company, reports of some dovish Fed committee members, and a government bond buyback announcement combined forces to boost markets on Wednesday.  The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite also closed up 0.2%.  The Treasury Department’s announcement this morning also helped calm the bond market—though for how long remains to be seen after the U.S. debt crossed a $40 trillion threshold on Wednesday.

items.title: Why Pfizer (PFE) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of global pharmaceutical company Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) jumped 3.8% in the afternoon session after positive clinical trial results from peers Merck and Moderna for an mRNA cancer treatment lifted sentiment across the pharmaceutical sector.
